in_hebrew.name: ברקמן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Berkman in Hebrew is derived from the Hebrew word ברק (berak), meaning 'strong,' and the suffix -man, which means 'man' or 'son of.' Thus, Berkman in Hebrew can be translated as 'strong as a wild ox man' or 'son of the strong one.'

in_greek.name: Βερκμάν
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Berkman in Greek is derived from the Greek words βέρκος (berkos), meaning 'strength,' and άνήρ (aner), meaning 'man' or 'husband.' Thus, Berkman in Greek can be translated as 'strength of man' or 'man of strength.'

in_latin.name: Berkmanus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Berkman in Latin is derived from the Latin word berkus, meaning 'strength,' and the suffix -manus, which means 'man.' Thus, Berkman in Latin can be translated as 'strong man'.
